parser_family: PostgreSQL grammar (libpg_query extraction of the PostgreSQL server parser); same family as the C libpg_query path, Go pg_query_go, Python pglast and JavaScript libpg-query
api: pg_query::parse(local UTF-8 text, ParserOptions::DEFAULT) -> ParseResult; the harness reads the protobuf SelectStmt (target_list, where_clause, group_clause, sort_clause) and InsertStmt (relation, cols, VALUES lists) and walks the same tree, serialized through its own serde derive, for RangeVar, FuncCall, JoinExpr and A_Const nodes
coverage: Rust LLVM source coverage of the pg_query 18.1.0 binding (parse, protobuf decode and ParseResult) plus clang 23.1.3 LLVM source coverage of the libpg_query C vendored in the crate, compiled by its build script, in one profile; the build script's OUT_DIR copy is mapped back to the crate's libpg_query tree. libFuzzer sanitizer counters in the Rust crates and the C objects
scope: One SQL statement from local UTF-8 text with the default PostgreSQL grammar; valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls only, each matching the hand-written oracle summary. Integer constants are converted to decimal text, which equals the source text for these controls. The #line directives of the bison/flex outputs gram.c and scan.c are removed before the build so coverage maps to the pinned C files. Other parser modes are untested.
underlying_package: libpg_query (vendored in the pg_query crate: PostgreSQL 18 parser, scanner and protobuf output)
